<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0cm;"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">2.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposed dwellings, by reason of its poor layout, narrow width, internal configuration and circulation, with the insufficient floorspace for the combined living room and dining and kitchen for the 2 bedroom dwelling, the siting of bedroom 1 of Unit-01 next to the kitchen and dining room of Unit-02, and the lack of built in storages for both dwellings would provide prospective occupants with a substandard form of accommodation. This would fail to comply with the prescribed space standards set out within the London Plan and Nationally Described Space Standards issued by the Department for Communities and Local Government on 27th March 2015. Furthermore, the proposed bin store, by reason of its siting within the proposed dwellings, would give rise to substandard and poor quality accommodation to the detriment of the residential amenities of the future occupiers and would also be contrary to the Secure by Design principles. The proposed development would be contrary to policies D3 and D6 of The London Plan (2021), policies DM1 and DM26, of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the Housing Design Standards LPG (2023), Department for Communities and Local Government Technical Housing Standards – Nationally Described Space Standards (2015), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Documents Residential Design Guide (2010).</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">1.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;The subdivision of the building in its current form would significantly reduce the width of the dwellings. The proposed development would therefore appear contrived, incongruous, unsympathetic and unduly at odds with the established pattern of development along the streetscene. The proposal would thereby be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies D3 and D11 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-family:Swiss721BT-Roman;color:red"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse into two separate dwellings (1 x 3 Bed and 1 X 2 Bed); single storey front extension incorporating front porch; two storey side extension; single storey rear extension; rear dormer; roof lights in front, side, and rear roof slopes; separate amenity space; landscaping; parking; refuse and cycle storage; external alterations
